about: Prologue music cues (plan 5.3), generated with ElevenLabs music (POST /v1/music, instrumental) by tools/sfx/generate.py --music into game/assets/story/music/<id>.ogg as loops. Wartung is three layers (drone, tension, percussion) that the game mixes by threat 0..2; the others are single loops. seconds: requested length; the loop is cut where the start and the later material match best, then crossfaded. gain: dB relative to -20 LUFS.

cues.prompt: Dark ambient drone for a sci-fi horror stealth game set in a dormant robot factory spaceship. Deep sub-bass drone in D, slowly evolving cold metallic textures, distant industrial resonances, no percussion, no melody, no vocals. Constant level from the first second to the last, no intro, no ending, no fade, seamless loop.
